view.sqlSentence: SELECT @ini:=(SELECT IF (SUM(inventory_detail.cost) IS NULL, 0, SUM(inventory_detail.cost * inventory_detail.actual_quantity)) FROM inventory, inventory_detail WHERE inventory.id = inventory_detail.inventory AND inventory.inventory_date = ?) AS inicial, @com:=(SELECT IF (SUM(invoice_detail.taxable_base) IS NULL, 0, SUM(TRUNCATE(invoice_detail.taxable_base * (IF (invoice.surcharge = 0,1,(invoice_tax.percentage + invoice_tax.surcharge + 100) / 100)), 2))) FROM invoice_detail, invoice, invoice_tax WHERE invoice_detail.invoice = invoice.id AND invoice_tax.invoice_detail = invoice_detail.id AND invoice.type = 0 AND invoice.issue_date BETWEEN ? AND ?) AS compras, @ven:=(SELECT IF (SUM(invoice_detail.taxable_base) IS NULL, 0, SUM(TRUNCATE(invoice_detail.taxable_base * (IF (invoice.surcharge = 0,1,(invoice_tax.percentage + invoice_tax.surcharge + 100) / 100)), 2))) FROM invoice_detail, invoice, invoice_tax WHERE invoice_detail.invoice = invoice.id AND invoice_tax.invoice_detail = invoice_detail.id AND invoice.type = 1 AND invoice.issue_date BETWEEN ? AND ?) AS ventas, @fin:=(SELECT IF (SUM(inventory_detail.cost) IS NULL, 0, SUM(inventory_detail.cost * inventory_detail.actual_quantity)) FROM inventory, inventory_detail WHERE inventory.id = inventory_detail.inventory AND inventory.inventory_date = ?) AS final, @ben:=(@ini + @ven - @fin - @com) AS beneficio, ((@ben / @com) * 100) AS sobre_compras, ((@ben / @ven) * 100) AS sobre_ventas
